# 1050 Highlands Dr, Erie, CO 80516 — Home for Sale

> Single-family home for sale in the Erie Highlands neighborhood of Erie, Colorado. 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, 2,366 sq ft, built 2022, listed at $625,000 by Michelle Sander of LIV Sotheby's International Realty (direct: 303-956-5082). Walkable to Highlands Elementary; four minutes from Old Town Erie.

Key facts: price $625,000 · 3 bed / 3 bath (2 full, 1 half) · 2,366 sq ft · built 2022 · attached 2-car garage · walkout lower level with 540 sq ft rec room · fenced cul-de-sac lot with fire pit · HOA ~$35/mo (pool, fitness center, clubhouse, playgrounds, trails) · St. Vrain Valley School District · listed June 24, 2026.
